h2.span: Overall issues and pull requests status

section.div: Flipper Zero RF analysis toolkit — spectrum capture, protocol inference, device fingerprinting and clustering. CC1101 driver, SD logging, session management.

Autonomous WPA/WPA2 handshake sniffer and AP logger for ESP32. Captures 4-way EAPOL exchanges to PCAP, logs every AP seen to CSV with RSSI and GPS coordinates, tracks device telemetry over time. Zero runtime heap allocations, RSSI filtering, FreeRTOS multitasking, optional Neo-6M GPS. ~15 EUR hardware. Authorised use only.

Passive Wi-Fi threat monitor for ESP32. Detects deauth floods, evil twin APs and beacon floods in promiscuous mode — no transmission, no config. Logs CSV to microSD. OLED display, single-button mode switch, FreeRTOS multitasking. ~11 EUR in parts.

Quiet home-network diagnostics in one small Go binary for Windows, macOS and Linux. Finds what's wrong and says it in plain English: Wi-Fi signal and crowding, latency, DNS, speed and bufferbloat, CGNAT, route, MTU, rogue DHCP, UPnP ports, captive portals, HTTPS interception. No admin rights for almost everything, no telemetry.
Monoscope lets you ingest and explore your logs, traces and metrics. We store these in S3 compatible buckets. Query in natural language via LLMs.
A unix-like system that hopes to pursue efficiency
Pocket25 - The Mobile P25 Radio Decoder
